+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                | **Unfractionated Heparin**                                                                              | **LMWH**                                                                                    |
+================================+=========================================================================================================+=============================================================================================+
| **Example **                   | Heparin                                                                                                 | Enoxaparin                                                                                  |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Uses**                       | Thrombosis prophylaxis and treatment                                                                    | Thrombosis prophylaxis and treatment                                                        |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Mechanism of action**        | Potentiates the effect on ATIII, rapidly increasing its anti IIa and anti Xa effect in 1:1 ration.      | Potentiates the action of ATIII increasing the inhibition of Xa and IIa. Xa\>IIa 4:1 ration |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                | Anti IIa effect requires triple combination AT/Heparin/thrombin - only achieved by long chain Heparins  | More predictable effect on Xa standardises dosage and relative lack of monitoring           |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                | In High Doses also inhibits platelet aggregation and other factors.                                     |                                                                                             |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Onset**                      | Immediate IV                                                                                            | Peak effect 2-4 hours                                                                       |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Monitoring **                | APTT or ATIII                                                                                           |                                                                                             |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **PK**                         |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Administration/                | Subcutaneous & IV                                                                                       | Subcutaneous only                                                                           |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
| Absorption                     |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Distribution                   | High protein binding → Variation of plasma concentration and unpredictable activity                     | Does not cross BBB or placenta                                                              |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                | Low lipid solubility and high MW→ does not cross BBB or placenta                                        | Reduced protein binding                                                                     |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Metabolism                     | Hepatically metabolised with saturable pathway → zero order kinetics                                    | Hepatically Metabolised                                                                     |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Elimination                    | Renal Excretion                                                                                         | Renal elimination of active drug and metabolites                                            |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Advantages/Disadvantages  ** |                                                                                                         | Single daily dose                                                                           |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                |                                                                                                         | Reliable Effect without monitoring                                                          |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                |                                                                                                         | Lower risk of thrombocytopenia                                                              |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                |                                                                                                         | Only SC administration                                                                      |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                |                                                                                                         | Longer elimination half life                                                                |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                |                                                                                                         | Difficult Monitoring                                                                        |
|                                |                                                                                                         |                                                                                             |
|                                |                                                                                                         | Accumulates in renal Failure                                                                |
+--------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Reversal **                  | Protamine                                                                                               | Incomplete reversal with protamine as only the anti-IIa effect is inhibited.                |
